column1: # SIAM 100-digit HOLDOUT A, family D10 (exp 215): a.s. growth rate |x_n|^(1/n) of random linear recurrences, x_0 = x_1 = 1
# reference = exp(lambda), lambda = Int log r dnu(r), nu the stationary law of the ratio chain r -> c + s/r (Furstenberg)

column4: source
